title: Object Lock
shortDescription: Protecting objects from deletion using Object Lock
metaDescription: Step-by-step instructions for managing VK Object Storage Object Lock via AWS CLI: configuring a default time-based lock on a bucket (default retention), enabling/removing an indefinite object lock (legal hold), setting/changing a time-based lock for a specific object (retention period / retain-until-date), as well as the conditions and procedure for bypassing the time-based lock with `bypass-governance-retention` (if permissions are available) and checking the current lock status.
